learning.title: Test children spawned with `deno run` need the root config, and process checks must not read /proc
learning.trigger: A test under tests/ spawns a child under narrow grants with `deno run`, or checks whether a process is still alive.
learning.mistake: A child script under tests/helpers started with `deno run` did not pick up the root deno.json import map, so its bare @bakery/* and npm specifiers failed to resolve. A liveness check with `Deno.lstat("/proc/PID")` raised NotCapable under the lane's grants.
learning.rule: Pass `--config` with the path of the root deno.json to every `deno run` child and set its cwd to the repository root. Check that a process exists with `/usr/bin/kill -0 PID` (exit 0 means alive), which needs no file read; `Deno.lstat("/proc/...")` needs `--allow-all`, which the test lanes do not grant. Use the exact grants the deployed process uses for the child, so a lookup the real process cannot make fails in the test.

verification.requirement: The restricted-grants runner case passes and reports its grants as narrow.
